college_identity.identity_notes: Formerly Motilal Nehru Regional Engineering College (MNREC), established 1961 as one of seventeen original RECs; converted to NIT and Deemed University status in 2002; declared Institute of National Importance under the 2007 NIT Act. Single main campus (~222 acres) in Teliarganj, Prayagraj. Was formerly an associated college of the University of Allahabad — explicitly verified as a DISTINCT institution from the University of Allahabad, which is a separate, older university. City name change from Allahabad to Prayagraj (2018) does not affect institutional identity; both names refer to the same location.
